title: Federal Judge Strikes Down Trump Immigration Policy Affecting 39 Countries
detail: A federal judge struck down a Trump administration immigration policy that had affected 39 countries, delivering the latest in a series of judicial setbacks to the administration's immigration enforcement agenda. The ruling adds to a growing list of court defeats for Trump's immigration crackdown, which has faced sustained legal challenges from civil liberties groups and state attorneys general.

media.caption: Federal judge blocks Trump immigration policy affecting 39 countries
